name: oppia-research-compass
description: Full read-only Oppia research runtime; private corpus excluded; schema-compatible empty starter.
long_description: Oppia Research Compass lets authorized Oppia research team members search historical research, browse studies and interviews, retrieve source-labeled evidence, compare findings, and audit evidence bundles. The plugin orchestrator routes remaining work to focused, source-traceable question-framing, interview, usability, competitive-analysis, netnography, persona, heuristic-evaluation, and CUJ skills. Eight of ten MCP tools operate directly on Oppia data. No AI Glossary, personal notes, automatic external-source runtime, or write tools are included. This source edition supplies zero real records. Configure OPPIA_RESEARCH_DB_PATH for an independently authorized compatible recipient corpus.

tools.name: oppia_research_overview
tools.description: Explain the Oppia corpus, tool hierarchy, freshness, privacy, and runtime policy.

tools.name: oppia_research
tools.description: Default Oppia-first router for broad research questions.

tools.name: search_oppia_research
tools.description: Search Oppia evidence and return source-labeled excerpts with stable IDs.

tools.name: get_oppia_record
tools.description: Retrieve one Oppia research record and its evidence index.

tools.name: get_oppia_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve one full Oppia evidence chunk by stable evidence ID.

tools.name: compare_oppia_findings
tools.description: Compare two bounded evidence searches inside the Oppia corpus.
